question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated authority as CCP General Secretary, including control over the Central Military Commission and security apparatus, underpins the 95.5% trader consensus that he will remain in power through the end of 2026. No formal leadership transition is scheduled before the 21st Party Congress in autumn 2027, where preparations center on potential fourth-term continuity rather than an immediate exit. Recent military personnel shifts have aligned elites without evident factional challenges capable of forcing removal, while economic pressures and external events have not produced institutional fractures. Traders price in low probability of abrupt change absent verified health disclosures or sudden elite realignment. Scenarios such as a major medical event, unexpected diplomatic crisis, or rapid internal realignment remain the primary variables that could still shift implied probabilities before year-end.
